comparison.assessmentMethod: Direct visual comparison of original 1365x930 game screenshots at matched 65.25 / 65.60 / 66.35 / 67.20 seconds, with 68.05 R28-only. Not AI-generated, not DCC concept rendering, not RGB percentage as ART score.

improvementsOverR27: R27's enormous near-left smooth gray bank is materially reduced in the early genuine camera frames

66.35/67.20/68.05: screen-right original turbine and assorted structural objects appear detached or floating because surrounding new landform does not visually connect them into a founded mass
Near/mid/far terrain hierarchy, quay-to-cliff load path, water inlet/sluice/outlet and source groups 34/12/42 are not legible as one coherent harbor at race speed
True Blender solids and source-GL screenshots do not establish human fun, hazard fairness, artistic acceptance, or release
visualReview.prohibitedResponse: Do not simply raise geometry/polycount, recolor the cyan sheet, duplicate columns, patch gray planar R27 terrain, or rerun CI to make rejected art green
visualReview.confidence: Qualitative critical assessment based on four time-matched original RAW pairs; not a measured human preference, and no claim of statistical confidence.

restoration: No restoration needed: temporary research copy only; source Game and active R12A artist Git blob remain unchanged. No protected source reversion attempted.
